evidence: In the 3D top and iso views the THT relay bodies K1-K4 abut the screw terminal bodies J1-J4 with no visible assembly gap, and the right-side L1/C1/C2/L2 passives are stacked nearly touching in a vertical column.
All four screw terminals sit along the bottom board edge with wire openings facing outward and an unobstructed path between each terminal face and the edge in the 2D, 3D top, and iso views.

The four relay channels repeat an identical driver-cluster layout (D5/R5/Q1/D1 through D8/R8/Q4/D4) at uniform pitch, with relays, driver clusters, and terminals each forming straight aligned rows in the 2D view.

In the 2D view the driver-cluster designators overlap each other and their pads (e.g. 'R R5' and 'Q1 D1' rendered directly over the dense pad clusters), and the L2/C2/C1/L1 labels sit on top of the tightly stacked right-side column.

Roughly the top third of the board plus wide left and right margins are completely empty while all parts are compressed into the lower-middle band, and the L2/C2/C1/L1 strip is stranded at the far right away from any functional group.
